recovery_contract: destination record survives the simulated response loss
local acknowledgment is absent in the response-lost phase
redelivery uses the original effect identity and payload root
the receipt passes the I05 provenance verifier
the local journal contains exactly one acknowledgment write
later redelivery does not append another local acknowledgment
rejection_witnesses: ready state skips the crash phase
nonclaims: no production worker or network delivery
no destination adapter refinement or runtime mounting
